pages.text: Cost: 180 biomass. Offer 2 Tissue Fiber, 2 Hive Vein, 2 Living Hive Tissue, 1 Hive carapace, 1 Evolved Ganglion.$(br2)Equip in the chest slot for +25 attack damage. All four add 100 to the opening hit before the infinite Strength multiplier.$(br2)Black currents pass over the chest, back and upper arms, fading before changing course.
